                                                                Abstract                              1.   Introduction

                                             Business requirements for enterprise software                Enterprise software systems accumulate business
                                         systems are rarely captured in structured form; the          logic over years of evolution, encoding rules and
                                         logic resides instead in source code, configuration files,   behaviors directly into source code, configuration files,
                                         and institutional memory. When these systems must be         and the institutional memory of personnel who may no
                                         migrated, extended, or audited, the absence of formal        longer be available. Modern microservice architectures
                                         requirements artifacts forces teams into expensive,          face the same documentation gap through different
                                         knowledge-losing manual reverse engineering.                 mechanisms, including sprint velocity pressures,
                                         This paper presents an agentic framework that                shifting team ownership, and the implicit assumption
                                         autonomously generates Business Requirements                 that working code is sufficient specification. In both
                                         Documents (bRDs) through reverse engineering of              cases, the Business Requirements Document (bRD),
                                         undocumented enterprise software. Seven specialized          which formally captures user journeys, business rules,
                                         agents collaborate to discover user journeys, extract        acceptance criteria, gap analyses, and risk dependencies,
                                         business rules, and synthesize a locked bRD from code,       is absent precisely when it is most needed.
                                         test suites, configuration, and available documentation,         The consequences are well understood in practice.
                                         supported by static analysis tools, guided by embedded       Migration programs stall on undiscovered behavioral
                                         expert practitioner cognitive models, and overseen           edge cases.      Compliance audits require expensive
                                         by human reviewers at controlled escalation points.          manual archaeology.       Producing a bRD manually
                                         Measured on actual execution traces across a real            demands a cross-functional team of business analysts,
                                         enterprise deployment, the framework generates               developers, quality engineers, and domain experts
                                         comprehensive bRDs in under nine minutes per service,        working in concert for weeks per component, decoding
                                         with extracted rules independently corroborated against      behavior from source code, test suites, configuration
                                         real production defect records. In a comparable prior        files, and tribal knowledge. Knowledge earned on
                                         migration to the same target architecture, delivery          one component does not transfer to the next. Every
                                         required over two years; on the present programme            engagement restarts from near-zero.

    The framework shows that automated requirements
reverse engineering at enterprise scale is achievable             6.   Conclusion
without sacrificing artifact quality, making bRD
generation a continuous activity throughout the                       Enterprise software systems carry decades of
migration lifecycle rather than a deferred one. The               behavioral knowledge that exists nowhere in formal
significance is concrete: a comparable prior migration            documentation.      This paper presented an agentic
to the same target architecture for another product line          framework that recovers it systematically through
required over two years of effort in practice, whereas            multi-source integration, static-first extraction, and
the framework produces the foundational artifacts for             embedded expert practitioner cognitive models.
an equivalent programme in days. On the modern                    Deployed on a real enterprise environment spanning
side, generated bRDs give feature development and                 modern microservices and a legacy migration pilot, the
agile delivery the behavioral baseline they rarely have,          framework shows that requirements reverse engineering
and the defect corroboration shows extracted rules                is tractable at scale and at negligible recurring cost,
match those developers independently relied on, so the            with extracted rules corroborated against independent
artifacts are faithful, not merely comprehensive.                 production defect records. The result is not merely
    Several limitations bound these results. The manual           a faster path to bRD generation but a foundation
baseline is modeled from actual repository metrics                for a fully agentic SDLC pipeline, in which design,
rather than observed directly, and the two cost sides are         development, testing, and deployment agents build on a
not accounted symmetrically, so the reported reduction            shared, machine-readable specification the knowledge
is an order-of-magnitude indication, not a controlled             layer maintains as the codebase evolves.
